notes.title: Video DevLogs for Floating in Space on YouTube
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while since our last update here, and we wanted to let you know what we’ve been up to! While it’s been quiet on Steam, we’ve been hard at work, and you can follow our progress in our Developer Vlogs on YouTube.

In these Devlogs, we dive into the latest developments, challenges, and exciting updates about our project. We’d love to hear from you feedback, ideas, or even suggestions for what you'd like to see in the next Devlog. Your input means a lot to us and helps shape the journey of this project!

Check out our YouTube channel [url=https://www.youtube.com/@FrogKin9]FrogKin9[/url] and let us know what you think.

The progress is still very slow, as we are working on this game in our free time. That makes your support all the more important.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Stay tuned for more updates, and we can't wait to share what’s coming next!

Best regards,
The Wingfinity Team
